learned_operation_rule: Collect candidate hrefs before save; use bounded scroll to discover more links; save only observed same-origin links and avoid start_url/exclude_urls.
assumptions_and_limits: Observed MDN content links are under main#content and share the /docs/ path. Use that content-area selector and path shape on other listing pages; scroll may reveal more. Up to max_items are saved; only same-origin links with nonempty labels are eligible.
